messages:
sam_ops: quick follow-up from today's all-hands infra section - thanks for the walkthrough! :clap:
sam_ops: two quick clarifications: (1) expected GPU SKUs and which pools they'll serve, (2) how the new burst policy interacts with warm pools and p99 latency

leah_infra: short answer: primary purchase is H100 + A100 for Dedicated and high-throughput Hosted tiers. We'll keep a mix of cheaper cards (T4/RTX) for low-cost embedding hosts and fallbacks. Shipments will arrive in two main waves over the next 6 weeks.

omar_sre: about warm pools: default min_warm per-region will be small (1-3 instances depending on cluster size). Warm pool hit rate aims to keep p95/p99 stable for typical spikes. Extreme burst (10x baseline) will spill to preemptible cloud capacity or fall back to smaller quantized model variants to preserve latency.

rachel_product: will this be surfaced to customers during signup or in the console capacity reservations? I want to make sure we don't oversell immediate APAC availability.

leah_infra: yes — console will show "estimated availability" per region when reserving Dedicated. Signup will include a short note about phased region rollouts. We'll also mark exact dates on the status page as inventory is confirmed.

maya_ceo: can infra produce a short FAQ and a one-pager for support by Friday? We need clear comms for PLG flows.

leah_infra: yep — drafting FAQ tonight. Key bullets: - Regions: NA prioritized, EU follows, APAC pilot dependent on local partners. - GPUs: H100/A100 for performance; T4/RTX for cost-optimized embedding nodes. - Autoscale: warm pools + preemptible burst + fallback to quantized variants for extreme spikes.

deploybot: [deploy] autoscaler v2 canary scheduled: 2026-06-15T03:00Z -> 10% Dedicated clusters. Watch metrics: autoscale_events, p99_latency, cold_start_rate.

omar_sre: config snippet for teams testing locally: ```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_warm_instances: 2
  burst_capacity_pct: 25
  cold_start_grace_ms: 150
```

sam_ops: great. one more question: any change to committed pricing or billing for burst usage?

leah_infra: committed Dedicated pricing unchanged. Burst (preemptible) usage is metered separately at burst rates; console will show estimated burst costs from historical traffic.

rachel_product: can we add a small banner on the reservation screen: "Region ETA subject to hardware shipments; reserve to lock your slot"? ops to draft language.

leah_infra: will add to backlog. Also creating an alert rule during rollout: if cold_start_rate > 5% for 10m then page SRE.

omar_sre: paging rule created and tested.

sam_ops: thanks — that should keep rollouts safe. Please ping #product-support when FAQ is live and I'll sync comms.

maya_ceo: thanks team. keep iterating on the visibility bits; transparency here reduces surprise for customers. :sparkles:
